title: MFA Plain Error
description: Legacy body several /api/v1/mfa/* routes return for failures that do not go through the canonical error envelope: `{success:false, error}` with NO `message` and NO `error_code` (for example 500 `Failed to disable MFA`, 500 `Failed to generate backup codes`, 400 `MFA was not enabled for this user`, 401 `Invalid recovery code`). Documented as-is so the contract matches the wire; new routes should use error_envelope_schema.json.

error.x-content-note: fixed server-side strings; never echoes client input
